notes: S2/F62/F63/F59 (§12.2 1e, decided by principle: the RFC 5280 module definition and its version constraints, never a parsing library's habits): the signer certificate is v1 (version absent, no extensions) and carries issuerUniqueID; RFC 5280 §4.1.2.8: the unique identifiers require v2 or v3. The certificate is re-signed with the test TSA key and the receipt carries it as signer certificate (ESS signingCertificateV2 updated). The case's trust anchor is that certificate when it is a well-formed X.509 certificate, otherwise the committed test TSA certificate (a malformed anchor is a usage error, §14.1).
